title: Policar

scope.basis: Modern Policar 1:32 track, borders, lane changer, power/timing assemblies and track-mounted hardware listed on the manufacturer site and catalogue pages 28–39.
excluded: Vintage Policar / Polistil pieces beyond adapter identity
Complete starter sets and cosmetic variants
P070 Polistil / Fleischmann powerbase kit pending assembly reference
Loose electrical spares, controllers, power supplies, cables and banners
scope.availability: Catalogue coverage is not a stock or availability claim.

defaults.note: 179 mm road width from dimensional flyer; 90 mm lane spacing from manufacturer prose. Centred offsets are derived, not directly dimensioned. Side-by-side modules consequently have a nominal 89 mm inter-module slot gap. Do not silently round width to 180 mm or claim uniform 90 mm spacing across nested modules.

visualStyle.road: Coarse black textured plastic; plain road without centre dashes
visualStyle.slots: Paired silver rails and dark guide slots
visualStyle.borders: Black textured 60 mm shoulders and raised outer lip; no coloured kerbs
visualStyle.accessories: Separate white/grey triple-rail guardrails, flexible barrier, blue bridge beams on black pillars
visualStyle.basis: Manufacturer catalogue photos inspected; original SVG interpretations, not copied product photographs

sources.note: Dimension diagram visually inspected; source saved in research/policar.

sources.title: Policar manufacturer track catalogue and specifications
sources.note: Checked 29 October 2026. Lists 90 mm lane spacing, 60 mm borders and product quantities. P058 angle conflicts with both PDFs.
